LESSON: GUIDED WRITING: VISUALS

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Writing 3.6 Guided Writing: Sentences (2 sessions) • Descriptive words • Simple 
Topic 3.8: Guided Writing: Visuals
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Writing: Visuals, part of Writing 3.6 Guided Writing: Sentences (2 sessions) • Descriptive words • Simple  in Grade 6 ARABIC LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: How do weather patterns affect our daily life? 2. Why are pictures considered to be worth a thousand words?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. collaborate with peers to prepare a list of vocabulary related to the theme,

2. study visuals (pictures, illustrations) related to weather and interpret the information expressed,

3. work jointly to summarise information about the weather and environment into a picture,

4. team up to put together pieces of a picture to form a complete and meaningful whole,

5. conduct a Pictionary session to create visuals on various themes. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. collaborate with peers to prepare a list of vocabulary related to the theme,
2. study visuals (pictures, illustrations) related to weather and interpret the information expressed,
3. work jointly to summarise information about the weather and environment into a picture,
4. team up to put together pieces of a picture to form a complete and meaningful whole,
5. conduct a Pictionary session to create visuals on various themes. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Writing: Visuals together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Creativity and imagination: This is promoted as the learner explores creative ideas when working jointly to summarise

information about the weather and environment into a picture.

• Self-efficacy: This is enhanced as the learner shows concerted attention when collaborating with peers to conduct a

Pictionary session to create visuals on various themes.
